name: Repaired C11 with C++17 release sequences (RC17)
description: RC11 updated to account for the C++17 release-sequence definition: like RC11 (repaired seq_cst, no out-of-thin-air via acyclic(po|rf)), but a release sequence is continued only by read-modify-writes, not by later same-thread relaxed stores. It is therefore strictly weaker than RC11 (it admits a non-synchronising outcome RC11 forbids) and strictly stronger than C++17 (it keeps the no-thin-air axiom C++17 lacks). Mechanised by the rc17.cat model (vendored from gonzalobg/cpp_memory_model; herd7-checked).
